headline: 2019 executive order gives state and local governments a larger say in where refugees are resettled in the United States.
what_it_does: This order changes how the federal government works with states and local areas when placing refugees admitted to the country. Based on its title, it gives state and local officials a bigger role in decisions about refugee resettlement in their communities. The title alone does not describe the exact rules, steps, or deadlines.

who_it_affects.how: They get more involvement in decisions about whether and how refugees are resettled in their areas.

who_it_affects.group: Refugees admitted to the United States
who_it_affects.how: Where they are placed could depend more on the views of state and local officials.
These groups help place refugees and may need to work more closely with state and local officials.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 26, 2019; the source material does not give a specific start date.
